# Onis
Large, horned people that come in a variety of colors. Their accuracy with guns is terrible, but their physical strength brings them a lot of boons both in and out of combat.
## Background
Your species’ old name has been lost to time, but now the name once used to jeer at you has become your legacy.
Your kind were a sparse bunch, surviving in small tightly-knit colonies on the planet your kind call Oraagnus: but your small numbers were not to be underestimated. With bodies naturally composed of impressive muscle, your kind went about terrorizing neighboring species for whatever you needed. Whether that be resources, practice, or entertainment; nothing was out of your ancestor’s reach. Adorning fierce horns and heavy armor, your kind made quick work of enemies, going as far as to consume them in celebration.
But in recent cycles, survival has changed its form. Resources grow scarce, and unified galactic powers respond swiftly to open aggression. Some Oni have turned to mercenary work, selling their strength instead of taking freely. Others attempt diplomacy, though their presence alone unsettles most negotiations. The struggle between old instinct and new necessity defines your people now.
While some broke off in attempts to seek a more peaceful life, the fierce stories of your kin still linger behind your kind like a shadow. Over time, those stories became warnings told to children and soldiers alike. Entire trade routes would divert at rumors of an Oni warband sighting. Even when no attack came, fear did the work for you.
Your kind carry both legacies: the terror that built your name and the future that may change it.
## Diet
- Just about anything. Can even eat many things raw.
## Benefits
- They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less Blunt, Pierce, and Slash damage.[/color] - Does more damage in melee; [color=#1e90ff]25% more Blunt, Slash, Pierce, Stamina, and Structural damage.[/color] - Due to their big size, they can easily carry and pull any other species. - They are slowed down [color=#1e90ff]25% less[/color] by clothing. - They heal Brute, Airloss, Poison, and Burn damage very, very slowly when drinking Sake, and can choose to take a refilling Sake gourd with them in their loadouts. Sake also restores some hunger for them.
## Drawbacks
- Oni are [color=#FFA500]unable to fire any weapons accurately[/color], with reports of bullets managing to fire even behind them. - They are harder to carry and pull. - They are bigger than Humans, making them easier to hit. - They get hungry and thirsty much faster than most species. - Starving or being dehydrated deal some poison and airloss damage, and slows you far more than any other species.
